metadata.title: Vintage Cinematic Portrait with Geometric Sans-Serif

retrievalProfile.description: A moody, low-key close-up portrait featuring heavy grain and a single line of ultra-thin geometric sans-serif typography at the top edge.
excludeWhen: modern high-resolution digital look is needed
multiple blocks of text are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast portrait of a bearded man emerging from deep shadows, characterized by a warm, desaturated color palette and heavy film grain, topped with a minimalist line of thin, wide-set text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject emerging from dark negative space on the left
Typography aligned to the top right edge
Warm skin tones contrasting against a near-black background
Heavy textural grain unifying the image and text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, slightly off-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned in the upper-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes, down the face to the hands at the bottom, then up to the text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep, textured shadows occupy the right side and bottom of the frame.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm, desaturated ochre and tan skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the face and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and blacks

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with circular curves and straight stems.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all text elements.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 70s aesthetic and thin stroke.
Classic geometric sans-serif with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key, close-up portrait of a man with a beard, lit from the side to create deep shadows. Apply a heavy 1970s film grain and a warm, desaturated color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of uppercase text in the top right corner using an ultra-thin geometric sans-serif font with wide tracking in an off-white color.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting low-key with deep shadows?
Is the grain texture prominent across the whole image?
Is the text thin, uppercase, and geometric?
Is the color palette limited to warm earth tones and blacks?

mustRedesign: Do not include any price tags or stickers
Do not use modern, high-contrast digital fonts
Do not use vibrant or neon colors
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent grain across text and image
Ensure the text does not touch the edges of the frame
Verify the lighting creates a moody, cinematic feel
Confirm the color palette is cohesive and desaturated
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key portrait + Heavy film grain + Thin geometric sans-serif header = 70s Cinematic Aesthetic
